title: RRB ALP CBT 1 Result 2026 Out, Merit List Zone Wise PDF, Scorecard Link Active
fullContentHtml:
The Railway Recruitment Board has conducted the RRB ALP CBT 1 examination for Assistant Loco Pilot recruitment to fill 10,970 revised vacancies. The ALP CBT 1 Exam was conducted on 13th, 16th, 17th and 18th February. Candidates who appeared in the exam are now waiting for the RRB ALP Result 2026 is officially released on 12th June 2026. The result has been published in PDF format on regional RRB websites along with zone-wise cut-off marks. The Railway ALP Result 2026 includes the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates, who will then be eligible for the next stage of the selection process, CBT 2.

RRB ALP CBT 1 Result 2026 Out

The Railway Recruitment Board conducted the RRB ALP CBT 1 Exam 2026 for Assistant Loco Pilot recruitment. The RRB ALP Result 2026 PDF has been released on 12th June 2026 at the official website rrbcdg.gov.in. This year, a total of 10,03,719 candidates appeared for the CBT 1 exam against 10,970 vacancies. Candidates whose roll numbers are mentioned in the ALP CBT 1 Result PDF will be shortlisted for CBT 2. Shortlisted candidates will sit for CBT 2, which will be of 175 marks and 150 minutes duration. The RRB Loco Pilot CBT 2 Date will be held after 12th July 2026 by the Railway Recruitment Board.

RRB ALP CBT 1 Scorecard 2026

The RRB ALP score card 2026 has been released along with the CBT 1 result. This ALP scorecard is an important document and mandatory to download. Candidates have to carry this RRB ALP 2026 scorecard during the document verification (DV) process to verify the passing score. Failure to provide the score card during DV stage will lead to the cancellation of candidature. It is advised that candidates should keep the soft and hard copies of the RRB ALP result score card 2026 to make it easily accessible when required.

How to Download RRB ALP CBT 1 Result 2026?

Candidates can check their RRB ALP Result 2026 online through the official Railway Recruitment Board website. The result will be available in PDF format, and candidates can easily find their qualifying status using their roll number.

  • Visit the official Railway Recruitment Board website: rrbcdg.gov.in.
  • Click on the “Results” section.
  • Select “CEN 01/2025 CBT 1 Result for ALP”.
  • Download the result PDF file.
  • Open the PDF and press Ctrl + F to search your Roll Number.
  • Check your qualifying status in the list.

What’s Next After RRB ALP CBT 1 Result 2026?

After the release of the Railway ALP Result 2026, candidates who qualify will move to the next stage of the selection process. The Railway Recruitment Board will shortlist candidates based on zone-wise cut-off marks, and only those whose roll numbers appear in the result PDF will be eligible for CBT 2.

RRB ALP CBT 2 Exam Date 2026

Along with the result, the Railway Recruitment Board will upload an official notice regarding the RRB Assistant Loco Pilot (CBT 1) Exam Schedule 2026. It is expected that the RRB ALP CBT 2 Exam Date 2026 will be held after 12th July 2026 in two shift. The Hall Ticket and City Slip will be available 4 days and 9 days respectively before the exam date.

RRB ALP CBT 2 Exam Pattern 

Qualified candidates will appear for CBT 2, which is the main written stage of selection.

  • CBT 2 is divided into Part A and Part B.
  • Total marks: 175 marks.
  • Duration: 150 minutes.
  • Part A includes Mathematics, Reasoning, Basic Science & Engineering, General Awareness and Current Affairs.
  • Part B includes trade-specific technical questions based on qualification.
  • Part B is qualifying in nature with minimum 35% marks required.

RRB ALP Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. In which month will RRB ALP Result 2026 be announced?

Ans: The RRB ALP Result 2026 for CBT 1 has been released in 12th June 2026 at the official website of regional RRBs in the form of PDF.

Q2. How can I see my RRB ALP CBT 1 Result 2026?

Ans: Candidates can visit the regional RRB websites like rrbcdg.gov.in or others depending on zones and can download result in the form of PDF.

Q3. What does Railway ALP Result 2026 PDF contains?

Ans: The result PDF will contain roll numbers of eligible candidates, cut-off marks for CBT 2.

Q4. What steps follow after clearing RRB ALP CBT 1 examination?

Ans: Eligible candidates need to give CBT 2 exam (of 175 marks and 150 min duration) followed by CBAT, DV, and Medical.

Q5. What is the criteria for selecting candidates for the post of RRB ALP?

Ans: Selection depends upon performance in CBT 2 Part A, CBAT, Document Verification and Medical Fitness.
